title: The AI Invoice That Does Not Peak: Cost Management Through 2027
subtitle: Deloitte Finance Trends 2027, covered again on 21 September 2026: 60 percent of 1,434 finance leaders expect AI costs and complexity to rise substantially through 2027. A mid-market CFO must choose a cost-control architecture before budget lock.
category: AI Cost Management, Capital Allocation & CFO Judgment
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 22 September 2026. Public facts: Deloitte survey of 1,434 finance leaders in 26 countries (companies with at least USD 1 billion revenue). 60% expect AI costs and complexity to rise substantially through 2027 and say they will need more sophisticated AI cost-management practices; 35% expect costs to remain modest. 43% list embedding AI to automate operations among top-three priorities; 34% cite enterprise cost efficiency; 33% cite capital allocation. 54% lead enterprise AI and technology capital allocation; 48% oversee AI and technology spending. 66% approve large AI investments through an internally driven measurement process; 27% of those use stage-gate funding. BeSmartee CFO Mina Samaan (CFO Dive, 1 September 2026) started budget season in May to size AI tool costs and uses Claude in Excel with a USD 500 usage alert. On 10 September 2026, Runway Financial rebranded as cfo.ai and launched Ari, an agentic CFO for founders. Composite firm: Coastal Grid Components Pvt. Ltd. Composite CFO: Nandini Rao.
thumbnail: 60% OF FINANCE LEADERS EXPECT AI COSTS TO RISE SUBSTANTIALLY THROUGH 2027. 35% STILL THINK THE BILL STAYS MODEST.
